'''Damian Siegtreg''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was present on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in [[3627 BBY]], where he [[Instructor/Legends|instructed]] others on [[Synthweaver|synthweaving]].<ref name="TOR" />
